The cloud security landscape is undergoing a major transformation. As organizations continue to scale in the cloud, they’re rethinking how to secure sprawling infrastructure, distributed identities, shifting workloads, and complex development pipelines. This shift is driving rapid adoption of a new category: Cloud-Native Application Protection Platforms (CNAPP).

We’re excited to share that Wiz has been named to the Leaders Category in the IDC MarketScape for Worldwide CNAPP 2025 vendor assessment, which assesses capabilities and strategic vision.

A big thank you to IDC and Senior Research Manager Phil Bues for leading the way with this comprehensive assessment. The report offers timely guidance for security leaders evaluating how to replace fragmented point tools with a unified, context-rich approach to cloud security.

IDC MarketScape vendor analysis model is designed to provide an overview of the competitive fitness of technology and suppliers in a given market. The research methodology utilizes a rigorous scoring methodology based on both qualitative and quantitative criteria that results in a single graphical illustration of each supplier’s position within a given market. The Capabilities score measures supplier product, go-to-market and business execution in the short-term. The Strategy score measures alignment of supplier strategies with customer requirements in a 3-5-year timeframe. Supplier market share is represented by the size of the icons.

Why CNAPP matters

According to the IDC Marketscape, "When selecting a cloud-native application protection platform vendor, it is essential to consider several factors beyond just vendor and tool consolidation. While reducing the number of vendors and tools can streamline operations, the primary drivers should include the platform's ability to integrate seamlessly with your existing security infrastructure and enhance your overall security posture."

This convergence is more than a trend. It reflects a deeper need for collaboration across security, DevOps, and engineering—with shared visibility, unified policies, and scalable workflows that keep up with cloud speed.

Look for a solution that offers robust monitoring and reporting on cloud security posture, runtime, and application security. The goal is to select a platform based on its aggregate capabilities rather than merely reducing the vendor footprint.

IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Cloud-Native Application Protection Platforms 2025 Vendor Assessment (Doc #US53549925, June 23, 2025)

CNAPP in practice

Organizations adopting CNAPP are seeing real-world results. At Wiz, we’ve seen this firsthand: over 50% of our customers now maintain zero critical issues in their environments. This isn't just a security win—it’s an operational shift toward agility with confidence.

What the IDC MarketScape highlighted about Wiz

In naming Wiz to the Leaders Category, the IDC MarketScape pointed to several key strengths:

“Customers appreciate proactive monitoring, strong support, and the platform's scalability across multicloud environments. Wiz's strategic partnerships with major cloud providers enhance its capabilities. The platform’s flexibility, responsiveness to customer feedback, and ability to add custom context to the reasoning engine are also significant strengths. In addition, the system health dashboards and extensibility model for custom workflows are highly valued by users.”

“The acquisition by Google Cloud is expected to improve how security is designed, operated, and automated, providing an end-to-end security platform for customers with a focus on AI.”

Wiz’s strengths, as highlighted by customers, include its agentless cloud security, which simplifies deployment and management. The centralized dashboard provides comprehensive visibility, integrating various security capabilities such as auto-discovery, vulnerability prioritization, and remediation workflows.

IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Cloud-Native Application Protection Platforms 2025 Vendor Assessment (Doc #US53549925, June 23, 2025)

A milestone for the market

The 2025 IDC MarketScape is more than just a snapshot of vendor capabilities. We believe it’s a signpost for the future of cloud security—one where prioritizing security outcomes, real-time context, and team collaboration are no longer optional.

We’re honored to be included in this foundational report, and we’re excited to help shape what’s next.

See Wiz in Action

Transform your cloud security operating model with a single platform that enables collaboration between developers and security.

Get a demo

Source: IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Cloud-Native Application Protection Platforms 2025 Vendor Assessment (Doc #US53549925, June 23 2025)

As organizations move faster in the cloud, security teams need more than visibility—they need a way to ensure critical risks are prioritized and remediated across the business. Wiz makes that possible by providing unified visibility and contextual risk analysis across every layer—cloud infrastructure, workloads, identities, data, code and more—Wiz helps teams focus on the most impactful security issues and take action.

But even with powerful prioritization, ensuring those risks are resolved quickly depends on getting context into the hands of the right teams, in the workflows they already use.

That’s why we’re excited to announce that Wiz is now available on the Zendesk Marketplace. This integration automatically turns high-priority Wiz Issues into actionable, context-rich Zendesk tickets—so security, engineering, DevOps, and platform teams can resolve risks faster, without friction.

From Wiz Issues to Resolution: Turning Critical Risks into Action

In cloud environments, risks are often presented in silos—but when they’re unified, security teams gain visibility into toxic combinations: interconnected risk factors that together form a critical attack path with real business impact.

These combinations are rarely obvious when viewed in silos. A publicly exposed VM might not seem urgent. A bucket with plaintext secrets might feel manageable. But when that VM can access the bucket—and has a known exploitable vulnerability—it becomes a real, high-priority issue.

Wiz continuously scans your environment using an agentless approach and visualizes these relationships through the Wiz Security Graph. This graph maps how risks across resources, identities, and data connect—surfacing only the most urgent, toxic combinations as Wiz Issues.

With the Zendesk integration, organizations can extend this deep context into their existing operational workflows—ensuring that prioritized risks are immediately routed to the right teams and resolved quickly.

With this integration, you can:

Automatically create Zendesk tickets for Wiz Issues based on filters like severity, environment, or resource type

Enrich tickets with full context, including affected resources, risk types, and recommended remediation steps

Route tickets to the right teams using existing Zendesk queues and automation rules

Track resolution directly in Zendesk, so engineers stay in flow and always have the context they need

By embedding prioritized risk data into the tools where teams already work, Wiz helps organizations scale remediation without slowing down velocity.

Scale Security Without Slowing Teams Down

This integration is built for organizations that want to shift from reactive cleanup to proactive, efficient remediation. By bringing prioritized risk context directly into Zendesk, teams across security, DevOps, and engineering can take faster, more informed action. Here’s how each team benefits:

Security Teams

Use Wiz Automation Rules to define exactly when and how Issues should trigger Zendesk tickets. Reduce manual triage, minimize alert fatigue, and ensure accountability.

DevOps & Platform Engineers

Receive clear, actionable tickets in Zendesk. Each one includes the Issue summary, why it matters, and how to fix it—no need to log into another tool or ask for context.

Developers & Application Teams

For teams that use Zendesk to manage internal requests or product work, Wiz Issues show up as part of their regular workflow—making it easier to address security without slowing development velocity.

Start Operationalizing Security in Zendesk

The Wiz + Zendesk integration is live on the Zendesk Marketplace, customizable with flexible rules based on risk and context, and secure by design with scoped API access and authentication.

This integration is part of the Wiz Integration Network (WIN)—our ecosystem of integrations that bring Wiz into the tools and workflows your teams already use. From collaboration to ticketing to SIEM and beyond, WIN helps operationalize security across your entire environment. Explore all Wiz integrations here.

As AI becomes the foundation of modern enterprise infrastructure, organizations face a dual mandate: secure the infrastructure powering AI, and leverage AI to drive smarter, faster security outcomes. According to Wiz’s State of AI in the Cloud 2025, 85% of organizations are already using either managed or self-hosted AI services or tools, signaling a rapid shift from experimentation to enterprise-wide integration.Wiz is proud to be a part of the NVIDIA Enterprise AI Factory — a validated design that helps enterprises build and deploy secure, scalable AI using NVIDIA’s full-stack AI platform.

Wiz provides AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM) capabilities to secure NVIDIA-accelerated workloads, offering full-stack visibility into models, configurations, and data flows to detect misconfigurations, excessive permissions, and toxic risk combinations. At the same time, Wiz leverages AI — including running NVIDIA NIM microservices — to power advanced use cases like automated data classification, AI-guided remediation, and natural language investigation, helping security teams operate with greater speed and intelligence.

From securing AI workloads running on NVIDIA accelerated computing to enhancing security workflows with NVIDIA-driven inference, Wiz is helping organizations confidently accelerate their AI transformation and make AI a core part of modern cybersecurity.

Securing AI: Protecting NVIDIA-Accelerated Workloads with Wiz AI-SPM

As enterprises build and innovate with AI, security can’t be an afterthought. Wiz’s architecture delivers real-time protection, visibility, and governance for enterprise-scale AI deployments. Wiz AI-SPM (AI Security Posture Management) gives enterprises the tools to govern and secure AI environments at scale — including NVIDIA-accelerated infrastructure.

In the validated design architecture, Wiz delivers:

Visibility and governance at scale: Inventory AI services across your environment and align deployments with internal policies and compliance requirements.

Model scanning: Analyze AI models to detect malicious behavior, known threats, and vulnerable model configurations.

Attack path analysis: Identify critical risks in AI infrastructure, such as publicly exposed virtual machines with excessive permissions and access to sensitive data.

Sensitive data scanning: Detect sensitive data flowing through AI pipelines and flag unintentional exposure risks.

Runtime threat detection: Deploy the Wiz Runtime Sensor on NVIDIA DGX System to detect advanced attack techniques — including model escapes and unauthorized access.

Leveraging AI to Strengthen Security

Wiz doesn’t just secure AI — we use it to make cloud security smarter, faster, and more effective. By embedding AI across the platform, Wiz helps teams reduce manual work, cut through noise, and respond to risk with greater speed and precision. From intelligent data classification to AI-driven remediation and investigation, Wiz gives security teams the context they need to focus on what matters — without being buried in alerts or complexity.

AI-Powered Data Classification (with NVIDIA NIM):

In a recent research collaboration with NVIDIA, the Wiz Research Team used NVIDIA NIM microservices for Meta Llama 3 models to classify sensitive data across cloud databases using only metadata. Running inference through NIM allowed us to process more data, more accurately, in less time — a powerful combination for security use cases like Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). NVIDIA NIM delivered up to 2x performance improvements over standard frameworks, enabling organizations to scale data discovery and sensitivity classification across environments.

AI Remediation and Mika AI:

AI powers everyday workflows in Wiz, helping teams investigate and remediate faster — and collaborate more effectively. AI-driven remediation guidance provides context-aware fix suggestions to accelerate resolution. Mika AI, our natural language assistant, LLM, makes it easy to query the Wiz Security Graph. Teams can also generate Rego policies with AI and get platform-specific answers through our Slack AI Assistant — all to simplify complex tasks and speed up time-to-value.

AI for Security. Security for AI.

With Wiz and NVIDIA, enterprises can confidently scale their AI initiatives — knowing they’re protected every step of the way. Whether you're deploying DGX systems, deploying models with NIM, or operationalizing AI across teams, Wiz provides the visibility, protection, and AI-driven capabilities needed to succeed.

Looking ahead, deepening our collaboration with NVIDIA to help organizations secure their AI innovation and accelerate security outcomes through AI — empowering teams to move faster, build smarter, and stay ahead of evolving threats in the AI era.

Today we’re excited to announce that Wiz Defend is now available as part of our FedRAMP-authorized offering, Wiz for Gov. Wiz Defend gives government teams and organizations with FedRAMP requirements a unified way to detect, investigate, and respond to real threats.

Wiz Defend modernizes cloud threat detection by reducing alert fatigue and surfacing root cause for issues more quickly. This provides the necessary context to understand blast radius, threat impact, and how to disrupt the kill chain to minimize impact.

The challenge: Threat detection in the cloud is broken

For many federal teams, cloud SecOps is buried in a growing stream of alert and event noise, with remediation primarily conducted through brute manual effort. The volume of alerts can be staggering, and can quickly overwhelm the capacity of even seasoned security teams. Most tools lack the context to prioritize what really matters, let alone the ability to connect the dots across infrastructure and cloud environments. Analysts are forced to piece together fragmented data, hunting for root cause even while an active incident continues to evolve.

Even when alerts are valid, it’s hard to filter through and know which ones matter most, how disparate alerts may be connected, and who are the correct teams to notify before damage is done.

Today’s threats don’t follow old rules. With the rise of cloud-native tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), attackers can move through your environment without ever touching malware, jumping from a misconfigured workload to a compromised identity, and quietly pivoting across network, identity, application, and data layers. Traditional detection tools were built for endpoints and servers, not ephemeral cloud resources and API-driven infrastructure.

Meanwhile, public sector teams are under pressure to modernize quickly — but with limited resources and a growing cloud skills gap, legacy SecOps tools are holding them back.

Enter Wiz Defend for Gov

Wiz Defend solves this with a smarter, simpler approach to cloud detection and response. Built for the realities of modern cloud infrastructure it helps public sector and public sector adjacent teams detect, investigate, and react with speed and precision.

With the addition of Defend, Wiz for Gov helps cut through the noise, accelerate investigations, and stop active threats in their tracks. Defend enhances Wiz for Gov’s capabilities to correlate signals across your entire environment — cloud control plane, identity, data, workload runtime, network, and more — to provide even more clarity and contextual storylines for fast response.

How Wiz Defend works

Wiz Defend helps –

Filter through the noise to identify real threats: Defend continuously ingests telemetry and signals across your cloud environment, grouping related events and suppressing false positives. It provides high-fidelity detections, informed through a combination of behavioral analytics, thousands of built-in detections for cloud specific TTPs, real-time threat intelligence, and code-to-cloud context. This forms a clear, prioritized view of active threats, ensuring analysts can quickly view what truly matters.

Accelerate investigations with visual storylines: Instead of triaging a flood of disjointed alerts, Defend creates a unified attack storyline connecting events across layers, including identity, workload runtime, network, resources, and control plane. Analysts can quickly identify root cause, trace attacker movement, and understand the blast radius of an incident, all from a single view. Visual storylines show the full attack path and root cause, so teams can reduce Mean Time to Respond (MTTR) from hours to minutes.

End-to-end runtime protection: Wiz for Gov’s eBPF-based Wiz Sensor delivers deep runtime visibility across hosts and containers without requiring privileged access. This visibility, enriched with cloud context, allows Defend to track activity from code to runtime and enables full attack path tracing. Defend provides visibility earlier within the development lifecycle to help minimize the cloud attack surface and allow developers to detect and fix infrastructure drift in production environments. These capabilities allow Defend to connect an exposed secret in code to a real-world identity compromise in production, with the necessary context and details to direct remediation back at the source. This cross-layer correlation ensures precise threat detection, while response policies triggered by the Wiz Sensor allow real-time containment, such as isolating a workload or alerting a SIEM/SOAR system to stop suspicious behavior without slowing down production. This helps to not only shut down the compromise, but prevent the compromise from occurring again in the future.

Threat detection aligned to MITRE ATT&CK: Defend provides actionable guidance aligned to the MITRE ATT&CK framework so teams can strengthen their detection posture and ensure comprehensive readiness. Analysts can easily query raw data from both the cloud environments and the Wiz runtime sensor in an intuitive interface to answer complex questions about the cloud environment. All raw CSP, IdP, VCS, SaaS, and runtime telemetry is parsed and enriched in a single place, allowing powerful, complex, and precise queries across the different layers of the environment.

Accelerating compliance modernization for the Government

Government cloud systems are among the most targeted in the world, with state-sponsored and criminal actors constantly probing for weaknesses. Rapid threat identification is critical to protect mission-critical systems and data.

Likewise, FedRAMP-authorized cloud service offerings can enhance system monitoring with Wiz Defend’s continuous visibility across cloud infrastructure, identity, data, and workload runtime layers. This helps address several FedRAMP baseline controls including SI-4 (system monitoring) and AU-6 (audit record review, analysis, and reporting). Wiz Defend can help companies seeking to achieve and/or maintain FedRAMP compliance to reduce manual efforts surrounding audit readiness and continuous monitoring requirements. It also helps generate evidence for assessments, investigations, and reporting, simplifying compliance efforts while supporting mission assurance.

Federal agencies are shifting from static, point-in-time risk assessments conducted every few years to dynamic risk evaluation embracing secure software supply chains, continuous monitoring, and active cyber defense. This shift is outlined through the continuous Authorization to Operate, or cATO, model. Wiz for Gov provides a strong foundation for cATO, combining secure-by-design best practices enabled through Wiz Code, full-stack visibility and context with Wiz Cloud, and now real-time threat detection and response with Wiz Defend — empowering security teams to respond quickly while maintaining compliance and auditability.

“Real-time or near real-time data analytics for reporting security events is essential to achieve the level of cybersecurity required to combat today’s cyber threats and operate in contested spaces.” – Department of Defense, Continuous Authorization To Operate (cATO) Memo

Whether you’re a federal agency or a FedRAMP partner, Wiz Defend makes it easier to secure complex cloud environments with limited time and headcount.

Ready to modernize your cloud threat detection?

Wiz is proud to support the public sector with cloud security that’s built for mission-critical environments. With Wiz Defend for Gov, federal teams get the context and coverage they need to detect, investigate, and respond — all in one unified security platform.

Want to see how it works? Contact us to learn more or request access.
